newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder Oct operating revs rise.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder Oct operating revs rise.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc said on Friday total operating revenue in October rose 3.3 percent to $267.6 million from $259.1 million in the same month last year.
Year-to-date operating revenue rose to $2.34 billion from $2.26 billion by October 1995, the company said.
Newspaper revenue was up 11.1 percent to $240.8 million from $216.7 million in the same period last year, while year-to-date newspaper revenue rose 8.1 percent to $1.98 billion, Knight-Ridder said.
Total advertising lineage in October rose 17.5 percent to 3.6 million inches. It was up 14 percent year-to-date to 29.2 million inches, the company said.

Pro forma operating revenues were up 4.9 percent in October. Pro forma comparisons assume that Contra Costa Newspapers were part of Knight-Ridder since the beginning of last year and exclude Detroit newspapers, where there has been a strike, and Knight-Ridder Financial, which was sold in July 1996, the company said.
Revenue in October for Knight-Ridder's business information services were $26.8 million, down 36.8 percent in October 1995, it said.
